Maria C: hey @eng-infra — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5423
Small migration: add materialized view for user_events_agg + background backfill to replace heavy nightly job. can someone take a look? especially around locking and index strategy.

Raj P: looking now, can you paste the migration SQL and the backfill query?

Maria C: sure, pasted below — backfill is chunked by user_id and uses a cursor so shouldn't block primary writes:
```sql
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE user_events ADD COLUMN agg_week jsonb;
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW user_events_weekly AS
SELECT user_id, jsonb_agg(event) AS agg_week FROM user_events GROUP BY user_id;
-- backfill run in batches in python
COMMIT;
```

Cleo R: two quick flags — avoid table rewrite on ALTER with default non-null, so make column nullable then backfill + set not null. for the view, you probably want indexes on user_id for the aggregation query; also consider REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY to avoid locks.

Dan O: I can review after stand, pinging @Cleo if you want an extra set of eyes on the backfill job (dag changes). what's the expected runtime for backfill? we might need a maintenance window if it's >2h.

Maria C: estimated ~90m on prod read replica if we chunk at 10k users/batch. backfill DAG will run on dedicated worker to avoid starving other jobs. no downtime expected. added idempotency check to job.

ci-bot: CI: migration check ✅  docker-tests ✅  schema-lint ✅

Raj P: left a small comment on PR about CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY and wrapping the backfill in a retryable transaction. otherwise LGTM.

Cleo R: added a runbook snippet for rollback and rollback sql. leaving approval once Raj + Dan confirm.

Dan O: reviewed the backfill code, small nit on logging, but approved. 👍

Raj P: approved. :shipit:

Maria C: thanks team — merged and scheduled the DAG to run Thu 03:00 UTC. will post postmortem if anything odd shows up.
